sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: A short value as a chip: a state, a version, a count, a tag. Its variants say how loud it is; kind draws it in one of the six kind colors, a wash edged faintly in the color with its ink, for a categorical value a reader learns to tell apart at a glance (what sort of form a card is, which domain a code belongs to). The same value wears the same color wherever it is shown.

anatomy.container: The chip: 20 tall, padded 6 across and 2 down, rounded by radius-chip, a 1px edge (none but where a variant or kind draws one), text.badge, on one line; an icon, 12, before or after the words, 4 apart. As wide as its words.

variant.does: How loud it is: default on primary, secondary on secondary, destructive on a destructive wash, outline only edged, ghost bare, link in primary.

kind.does: One of the kind colors, laid over the variant: the color's wash at 12 percent, its edge at 30, its ink. kindOf(name) picks one steadily from a name, so the same value always wears the same color.

children.does: The words, with an icon before or after them.

hover.means: The pointer is over it: only ghost and link answer, and a badge drawn as a link (default, secondary, destructive and outline then wash too).

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a badge drawn as a link: the focus outline.

keyboard.does: Reaches a badge drawn as a link (render); a plain badge takes no focus.

sokkel-ui: Base UI's useRender: render draws it as another element, such as a link, whose hover then washes default, secondary, destructive and outline ([a]:hover).
An aria-invalid badge wears the shared issue edge (INVALID_EDGE).
